observations: [synthetic decision setup] A proposed cross-venue Bitcoin strategy leaves 60% of inventory as an exchange account claim.

observations: [historical reconstruction] MtGox has applied for Japanese civil rehabilitation after severe operating difficulties and missing Bitcoin.
